title: The craft of cutting and hanging paper ceilings
summary: He describes cutting paper with a razor, hanging it in rotation, working with Brother Fortuny, and picking up the skill without training.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers

blocks.x: Yeah. Well, what do you call that when you decorate ceiling? Is that like a trade? Does it have a name? Like, like being a plaster or a paper hanger or?

You have to cut it. Yeah. You have to cut it with a razor blade. You have to get a table, put it out there, make your measurements. To keep from getting out of line, you have to have them all the same size because it wouldn't look right. And when you put them up, they all in rotation. They hang just like this lamp, this lampshade. They hang just like that. I see. And it was all different colors. Beautiful scenery. Oh, yeah. That's really interesting.
I don't know they decorated the hall so fancy. Oh, yeah. Oh, yeah.

Me and him used to work together, you see. And otherwise I couldn't do that by myself. Because I used to cut the paper and he'd hang it.
